name: builderforce-vscode-analyzers
description: The code-pack analyzers the VSIX ships (PRD 41 A3). esbuild.mjs installs these into out/analyzers/ at build time; src/bundledAnalyzers.ts resolves their entry scripts. Versions are pinned HERE and in packages/agent-tools/src/codeAnalysisTool.ts (ANALYZERS); a test keeps the two equal.
